blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lone bettor won the P94.81 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot drawn on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026. This was according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). But the jackpots of the 2 other major lotto draws on Oct. 13, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Super Lotto 6/49, have remained unwon. READ: Lotto results for Oct. 12, 2026 According to the PCSO, one ticket holder picked the winning Lotto 6/42 combination of 42-05-15-26-19-40, which carried a jackpot of ₱94.81 million.
